tasks.label: Mosaic: Classify Changes
tasks.command: $json = python -B .\scripts\mosaic_validation_policy.py --base origin/main --head HEAD --include-working-tree; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Mosaic change classification failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)." }; $result = $json | ConvertFrom-Json; $unknown = @($result.paths | Where-Object releaseRelevance -eq 'unknown'); Write-Host "Requested level: Full"; Write-Host "Release relevance: $($result.releaseRelevance)"; Write-Host "Validation risk:    $($result.validationRisk)"; Write-Host "Selected path:      $($result.validationMode)"; Write-Host "Release required:   $($result.releaseRequired)"; Write-Host ""; if ($unknown.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host "No unknown paths." } else { Write-Host $unknown.Count 'unknown path(s):'; $unknown | Format-Table path, reason, validationRisk -AutoSize }
